🔢 Real Numbers & Powers实数与幂

The real number system实数系统

Is 49​ the same kind of number as 50​? One is exactly 7; the other has decimals that never end and never repeat — and that difference decides how you can work with it.49​ 和 50​ 是同一类数吗？前者正好是 7，后者的小数既不终止也不循环——这个区别决定了你能怎样处理它。

Difficulty难度 ●○○
⏱ 20 min

🔑 Must know必须记住 · The real number system实数系统
  1. N⊂W⊂I⊂Q⊂R; 0 is whole but not natural.N⊂W⊂I⊂Q⊂R；0 是非负整数（W），但不是自然数。
  2. Rational = ba​ with integers a,b: decimal ends or repeats. Irrational: never ends, never repeats.有理数＝两个整数之比 ba​，小数会终止或循环；无理数的小数不终止也不循环。
  3. Simplify before classifying: 49​=7, 3−8​=−2; −4​ is not real.先化简再分类：49​=7，3−8​=−2；−4​ 不是实数。
N⊂W⊂I⊂Q⊂R,R=Q∪Q​
0.ab=99ab​

🧗 The hard part难点 · The real number system实数系统

A decimal that repeats only after a delay「晚开始循环」的小数化分数

With digits before the repeat, 10x−x no longer cancels the tail, so you must shift twice.循环节前面还有不循环的数字时，10x−x 消不掉尾巴，要移位两次。

  1. x=0.16
  2. Line up the repeats: 100x=16.6, 10x=1.6让循环部分对齐：100x=16.6，10x=1.6
  3. Subtract: 90x=15 → x=9015​=61​相减：90x=15 → x=9015​=61​
Try试一试
Write 0.27 as a fraction in lowest terms.把 0.27 写成最简分数。
Answer答案
100x−10x=27.7−2.7, so 90x=25 and x=185​.100x−10x=27.7−2.7，所以 90x=25，x=185​。

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · The real number system实数系统
  • 2π​ "looks like a fraction" → rational ✗. Top must be an integer: it is irrational.2π​「长得像分数」所以是有理数 ✗。分子必须是整数，它是无理数。
  • Root sign → irrational ✗. 16​=4 is an integer.有根号就是无理数 ✗。16​=4 是整数。
🎯
Decide from the exact form, never from a calculator display.看精确形式下结论，别看计算器屏幕上的小数。

🔢 Real Numbers & Powers实数与幂

Exponent laws (zero & negative)指数律（零指数与负指数）

Why is 50=1 and 2−3=81​? Once you see the pattern, a messy expression like 4x−1y(2x3y−2)3​ collapses in four lines.为什么 50=1、2−3=81​？看懂规律后，像 4x−1y(2x3y−2)3​ 这样的式子四行就能化简完。

Difficulty难度 ●●○
⏱ 30 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Exponent laws (zero & negative)指数律（零指数与负指数）
  1. Same base: multiply → add exponents, divide → subtract, power of a power → multiply.同底数：相乘指数相加，相除指数相减，乘方的乘方指数相乘。
  2. An outside power hits every factor, numbers too: (3x2)3=27x6.括号外的指数作用到每个因式上，系数也要乘方：(3x2)3=27x6。
  3. a0=1; a−n=an1​ — a negative exponent means reciprocal, never a negative number.a0=1；a−n=an1​——负指数表示倒数，不是负数。
am⋅an=am+n,anam​=am−n,(am)n=amn
(ab)n=anbn,(ba​)n=bnan​

🧗 The hard part难点 · Exponent laws (zero & negative)指数律（零指数与负指数）

A negative exponent on a whole fraction整个分式带负指数

Negatives inside and outside interact, and it is easy to lose which factor moves where.括号内外都有负号，容易搞乱哪个因式该移到哪边。

  1. Flip to kill the outside negative: (3a−2b​)−2=(a−2b3​)2先翻转去掉外面的负指数：(3a−2b​)−2=(a−2b3​)2
  2. Move a−2 up: (b3a2​)2把 a−2 移上去：(b3a2​)2
  3. Square every factor: b29a4​每个因式都平方：b29a4​
Try试一试
Simplify (2x−3y2​)−3 with positive exponents.化简 (2x−3y2​)−3，用正指数表示。
Answer答案
(y22x3​)3=y68x9​

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Exponent laws (zero & negative)指数律（零指数与负指数）
  • 2−3=−8 ✗ → 2−3=81​.2−3=−8 ✗ → 2−3=81​。
  • −32=9 ✗ → −32=−9, but (−3)2=9.−32=9 ✗ → −32=−9，而 (−3)2=9。
🎯
Clear brackets first, then move every negative-exponent factor across the bar in one pass.先去括号，再一次性把所有负指数因式移到分数线另一侧。

🔢 Real Numbers & Powers实数与幂

Rational exponents分数指数

What could 82/3 possibly mean? Two-thirds of a multiplication sounds impossible — but it is just a cube root followed by a square, and it equals exactly 4.82/3 到底是什么意思？「乘三分之二次」听起来不可能——意思是先开立方再平方，结果正好是 4。

Difficulty难度 ●●○
⏱ 35 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Rational exponents分数指数
  1. am/n=(na​)m: bottom of the exponent = root, top = power.am/n=(na​)m：指数的分母是开方次数，分子是乘方次数。
  2. By hand, take the root first: 272/3=32=9.手算先开方，数字小：272/3=32=9。
  3. Negative exponent = reciprocal, never a negative answer: 16−1/2=41​.负指数＝倒数，结果不会变负：16−1/2=41​。
an1​=na​,anm​=(na​)m=nam​
a−nm​=anm​1​

🧗 The hard part难点 · Rational exponents分数指数

Solving xm/n=k when m is even解 xm/n=k（m 为偶数）

Raising to the reciprocal power hides the negative solution, so students give only one answer.直接乘方到倒数次会把负解藏起来，于是只写出一个答案。

  1. Clear the negative: x−2/3=41​ ⇒ x2/3=4先去负指数：x−2/3=41​ ⇒ x2/3=4
  2. Read it as (3x​)2=4 ⇒ 3x​=±2看成 (3x​)2=4 ⇒ 3x​=±2
  3. Cube: x=±8. Check: (−8)2/3=(−2)2=4 ✓立方：x=±8。检验：(−8)2/3=(−2)2=4 ✓
Try试一试
Solve x−2/3=41​.解方程 x−2/3=41​。
Answer答案
x=8 or x=−8x=8 或 x=−8

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Rational exponents分数指数
  • 82/3 = square root cubed ✗ → cube root squared: 22=4.82/3＝开平方再立方 ✗ → 开立方再平方：22=4。
  • (−16)1/2=−4 ✗ → not real; but (−8)1/3=−2 is fine (odd root).(−16)1/2=−4 ✗ → 不是实数；而 (−8)1/3=−2 没问题（奇次方根）。
🎯
On a calculator type 27^(2/3) with brackets; without them you get 272÷3.计算器要输入 27^(2/3)，带括号；不加括号会算成 272÷3。

quiz.q: Which number is irrational?下列哪个是无理数？
c: 81​
0.12
30​
−37​
quiz.a: 30​
quiz.sol: • 81​=9, 0.12 repeats, −37​ is a fraction of integers. 30 is not a perfect square, so 30​ is irrational.81​=9，0.12 循环，−37​ 是整数之比。30 不是完全平方数，所以 30​ 是无理数。
quiz.goal: Recognise an irrational number among perfect and non-perfect squares.在完全平方数与非完全平方数中认出无理数。
quiz.idea: A square root is irrational unless the number under it is a perfect square.被开方数不是完全平方数，平方根就是无理数。

quiz.q: Of the sets N,W,I,Q,Q​,R, name every one that −5 belongs to.在 N,W,I,Q,Q​,R 中，写出 −5 所属的全部数集。
quiz.a: integers, rational, real (I,Q,R)整数、有理数、实数（I,Q,R）
quiz.sol: • −5 is an integer; every integer is rational (−5=1−5​) and real.−5 是整数；每个整数都是有理数（−5=1−5​），也是实数。
quiz.goal: Name all the sets a negative integer belongs to.说出一个负整数所属的所有数集。
quiz.idea: It is not natural or whole, but every set from I upward contains it.它不属于 N 和 W，但从 I 往上的数集都包含它。

quiz.idea: Multiply by 100 and subtract.乘以 100 再相减。

not real; −5 (integer)不是实数；−5（整数）
quiz.a: 3−125​=−5 is an integer; −25​ is not real.3−125​=−5 是整数；−25​ 不是实数。
quiz.sol: • (−5)3=−125, so the cube root is −5. No real number squares to −25.(−5)3=−125，所以立方根是 −5。没有实数的平方等于 −25。

quiz.idea: Odd roots of negatives exist; even roots of negatives do not exist in the reals.负数的奇次方根存在；偶次方根在实数范围内不存在。

quiz.q: Between which two consecutive integers does 58​ lie? Is it rational?58​ 在哪两个相邻整数之间？它是有理数吗？
quiz.a: Between 7 and 8; irrational.在 7 和 8 之间；无理数。
quiz.sol:
• 49<58<64, so 7<58​<8.49<58<64，所以 7<58​<8。
  • 58 is not a perfect square, so 58​ is irrational (≈7.6158).58 不是完全平方数，所以 58​ 是无理数（约 7.6158）。
quiz.goal: Locate a radical between consecutive integers and classify it.把根式夹在相邻整数之间并判断其类别。
quiz.idea: Bracket 58 between perfect squares 49 and 64.用完全平方数 49 与 64 夹住 58。

quiz.q: True or false: the sum of two irrational numbers is always irrational. Test with 2​ and −2​.判断：两个无理数之和一定是无理数。用 2​ 和 −2​ 检验。
quiz.a: False: 2​+(−2​)=0, which is rational.错误：2​+(−2​)=0，是有理数。
quiz.sol: • Both are irrational, but their sum is 0, an integer. So the statement is false.两者都是无理数，但和为 0（整数），所以命题错误。
quiz.goal: Disprove a general claim about irrational numbers with a counterexample.用反例推翻关于无理数的一个一般性说法。
quiz.idea: One counterexample is enough to show a statement is false.举一个反例就足以说明命题不成立。

quiz.q: A designer cuts a square sign of area 50 cm2 and a circular badge with circumference 10π cm from a sheet. A classmate says: "Both measurements are exact, so the side of the square and the diameter of the circle must both be rational." Decide whether each length is rational, and explain why the classmate is wrong about at least one of them.设计师从一块板上裁出面积为 50 cm2 的正方形标牌和周长为 10π cm 的圆形徽章。同学说：「两个量都是精确值，所以正方形的边长和圆的直径都是有理数。」判断这两个长度是否有理，并说明同学至少在哪一处说错了。
quiz.a: Side =50​=52​ cm is irrational; diameter =10 cm is rational. An exact value is not the same as a rational value.边长 =50​=52​ cm 是无理数；直径 =10 cm 是有理数。「精确」不等于「有理」。
quiz.sol:
• Side: s=50​=52​. Since 50 is not a perfect square, 50​ is irrational.边长：s=50​=52​。50 不是完全平方数，所以 50​ 是无理数。
  • Diameter: d=C/π=10π/π=10, a whole number, so rational even though π appears in the data.直径：d=C/π=10π/π=10，是整数，尽管已知数据里有 π，直径仍是有理数。
  • So the claim fails for the square: "exact" means we keep the radical, not that the number is rational.所以同学的说法对正方形不成立：「精确」只是保留根号，并不表示是有理数。
quiz.goal: Use real-number classification to judge lengths coming from an area and a circumference.用实数分类判断由面积和周长得到的长度。
quiz.idea: Solve for each length exactly, simplify, then classify the result, not the given data.先精确求出每个长度并化简，再给结果分类，而不是给已知数据分类。

quiz.q: A BC lab grows a bacteria sample that triples every hour, so after t hours the count is N=500⋅3t. Using the same rule backwards in time, how many bacteria were there 2 hours before the count of 500 was taken, and how many hours before it were there 243500​? Explain why 30 and 3−2 make sense in this story.BC 一家实验室培养的细菌每小时变为原来的 3 倍，所以 t 小时后数量是 N=500⋅3t。把同一规律倒推时间：在记录 500 个之前 2 小时有多少个？数量是 243500​ 时是在多少小时之前？并说明为什么 30 和 3−2 在这个情境里是合理的。
quiz.a: t=−2 gives 9500​≈55.6 bacteria; t=−5, that is 5 hours before.t=−2 时数量是 9500​≈55.6 个；t=−5，即 5 小时之前。
quiz.sol:
• Two hours earlier: N=500⋅3−2=9500​≈55.6.早 2 小时：N=500⋅3−2=9500​≈55.6。
  • Solve 500⋅3t=243500​: 3t=2431​=3−5, so t=−5.解 500⋅3t=243500​：3t=2431​=3−5，所以 t=−5。
  • Meaning: 30=1 means no growth yet; each hour back divides by 3, which is exactly what 3−1, 3−2 do.意义：30=1 表示还没增长；每往回一小时就除以 3，正是 3−1、3−2 的含义。
quiz.goal: Interpret zero and negative exponents in a growth model and solve for an unknown exponent.在增长模型中解释零指数与负指数，并求未知指数。
quiz.idea: Going back one hour divides by 3, so negative exponents are the same pattern run backwards.往回一小时就除以 3，负指数就是同一规律倒着走。

quiz.goal: Combine several powers of x with fractional exponents and give a radical answer.合并若干分数指数的 x 的幂，并以根式作答。
quiz.idea: Add exponents on top, subtract the bottom, using a common denominator of 12.分子的指数相加、再减去分母的指数，通分到分母 12。

quiz.q: Solve x2/3=16.解方程 x2/3=16。
quiz.a: x=64 or x=−64x=64 或 x=−64
quiz.sol:
• (3x​)2=16 gives 3x​=4 or −4.(3x​)2=16，得 3x​=4 或 −4。
  • Cube: x=64 or x=−64. Both check: (3−64​)2=(−4)2=16.两边立方：x=64 或 x=−64。都成立：(3−64​)2=(−4)2=16。
quiz.goal: Solve an equation with a rational exponent and keep both real solutions.解含分数指数的方程，并保留两个实数解。
quiz.idea: Raise both sides to the reciprocal power 23​; the even root of the square brings in a ±.两边取倒数幂 23​；偶次根（平方）要带上 ±。

quiz.q: Earthquake energy: the energy E released (in some units) is related to magnitude M by E=101.5M. For a magnitude-4 quake the energy is E4​=106. Show that a magnitude-6 quake releases 1000 times as much, and write the ratio of energies between magnitudes M+2 and M as a power of 10. Then find the magnitude whose energy is 104.5.地震能量：释放的能量 E（某种单位）与震级 M 的关系为 E=101.5M。4 级地震的能量是 E4​=106。证明 6 级地震释放的能量是 4 级的 1000 倍，并把震级 M+2 与 M 的能量比写成 10 的幂。再求能量为 104.5 的震级。
quiz.a: Ratio =103=1000 for any M; the magnitude with E=104.5 is M=3.对任意 M，比值都是 103=1000；能量为 104.5 的震级是 M=3。
quiz.sol:
• Magnitude 6: E6​=109, and 109/106=103=1000.6 级：E6​=109，109/106=103=1000。
  • General: 101.5M101.5(M+2)​=101.5M+3−1.5M=103, independent of M.一般情形：101.5M101.5(M+2)​=101.5M+3−1.5M=103，与 M 无关。
  • 101.5M=104.5 gives 1.5M=4.5, so M=3.101.5M=104.5 得 1.5M=4.5，所以 M=3。
quiz.goal: Use rational-exponent laws inside a real model to compare two quantities and solve for an exponent.在实际模型中用分数指数律比较两个量并解出指数。
quiz.idea: A ratio of powers with the same base is a power of the exponent difference.同底数幂之比等于指数之差的幂。

diag.q: Which number is rational?下面哪个数是有理数？
c: 20​
3−64​
4π​
−36​
why: 20 is not a perfect square: 20​=25​ is irrational. Simplifying a root does not make it rational.20 不是完全平方数，20​=25​ 是无理数。能化简不等于有理。
Correct: 3−64​=−4, an integer, so it is rational.正确：3−64​=−4 是整数，所以是有理数。
Looks like a fraction, but the top π is not an integer — irrational.看起来像分数，但分子 π 不是整数，是无理数。
An even root of a negative is not a real number, so it is neither rational nor irrational (it is not −6).负数开偶次方不是实数，既不是有理数也不是无理数（它不等于 −6）。
diag.goal: Classify roots and fractions by evaluating first.先求值，再判断根式和分式属于哪类数。
diag.idea: Evaluate each one exactly; only then name its set.每个数先精确求值，再说它属于哪个数集。

diag.q: Which expression has a rational value?下面哪个式子的值是有理数？
c: 2​+8​
π−3
210​​
3​⋅12​
why: 8​=22​, so the sum is 32​ — still irrational. Adding roots does not "cancel" the irrational part.8​=22​，和是 32​，仍是无理数。根式相加不会把无理部分消掉。
Subtracting an integer only shifts the decimal: 0.14159… still never repeats.减去整数只是平移小数：0.14159… 依然不循环。
A fraction with an irrational top is irrational; "fraction form" is not the test.分子是无理数的分式仍是无理数，「写成分数样子」不是判据。
Correct: 3​⋅12​=36​=6.正确：3​⋅12​=36​=6。
diag.goal: Decide whether results of operations on irrationals are rational.判断无理数运算的结果是否为有理数。
diag.idea: Simplify each expression to an exact value, then classify.把每个式子化到精确值再分类。

diag.q: Simplify (2x−2)3.化简 (2x−2)3。
c: x66​
x62​
x68​
8x−5
why: Multiplied the coefficient by 3 instead of cubing it: 23=8, not 6.把系数乘以 3，而不是立方：23=8，不是 6。
Did not apply the power to the coefficient 2.没有把指数作用到系数 2 上。
Correct: 23⋅x−6=x68​.正确：23⋅x−6=x68​。
Added −2+3 instead of multiplying (−2)(3) for a power of a power, and left a negative exponent.乘方的乘方应把指数相乘 (−2)(3)，却做成了相加 −2+3，还留下了负指数。
diag.goal: Apply the power-of-a-product and power-of-a-power laws together.同时运用积的乘方和幂的乘方法则。
diag.idea: Cube each factor: 23 and (x−2)3.每个因式分别立方：23 和 (x−2)3。

diag.q: Simplify 9a−1b3(3a2b−1)2​ using positive exponents.化简 9a−1b3(3a2b−1)2​，用正指数表示。
c: b5a5​
b5a3​
3b5a5​
ba5​
why: Correct: 9a−1b39a4b−2​=a4−(−1)b−2−3=b5a5​.正确：9a−1b39a4b−2​=a4−(−1)b−2−3=b5a5​。
Sign slip: did 4−1 instead of 4−(−1) when dividing.符号错：相除时算成了 4−1，应是 4−(−1)。
Did not square the 3: (3)2=9 cancels the 9 below.没有把 3 平方：32=9 正好和分母的 9 约掉。
Added −2+3 for b when dividing; dividing subtracts: −2−3=−5.对 b 相除时把指数相加成 −2+3；相除应相减：−2−3=−5。
diag.goal: Combine power, quotient and negative-exponent laws in one expression.在一个式子里综合运用乘方、除法和负指数法则。
diag.idea: Square the top first, then subtract exponents base by base.先把分子平方，再逐个底数相减指数。

diag.q: Evaluate 32−3/5 without a calculator.不用计算器，求 32−3/5。
c: 81​
−8
8

why: Correct: 532​=2, 23=8, reciprocal 81​.正确：532​=2，23=8，取倒数得 81​。
Read the negative exponent as a negative answer; it means reciprocal.把负指数当成结果为负；负指数表示取倒数。
Ignored the minus sign in the exponent — forgot the reciprocal.忽略了指数上的负号，忘了取倒数。
Multiplied the base by the exponent; an exponent is not a multiplier.把底数和指数相乘了；指数不是乘数。
diag.goal: Evaluate a power with a negative rational exponent.求负分数指数幂的值。
diag.idea: Root (5th), then power (3), then reciprocal.先开 5 次方，再 3 次方，最后取倒数。

why: Subtracting −61​ was done as subtracting 61​: 21​+31​−61​=32​. Minus a negative is plus.减去 −61​ 被当成减去 61​：21​+31​−61​=32​。减负数等于加。

diag.goal: Combine exponent laws with fraction arithmetic.把指数法则和分数运算结合起来。
